# Security

Please report security problems privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/glorat/nethack-cocoa/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue. You should hear back within a week.

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/glorat/nethack-cocoa/releases/latest) gets fixes. Security problems in the NetHack game itself, rather than the Mac app, should go privately to the [NetHack DevTeam](https://www.nethack.org/common/contact.html).

Download the app only from this project's [releases page](https://github.com/glorat/nethack-cocoa/releases). It isn't notarized by Apple, so a copy from anywhere else can't be checked.
